objective: Build a standard-library JSON-stdin/JSON-stdout uppercase CLI with real automated unittest coverage.
public_behavior_spec: The CLI reads JSON input from stdin.
The input JSON contains a key 'text' with a string value.
The CLI outputs JSON to stdout with the 'text' value converted to uppercase.

public_tests.description: Test that the CLI converts input text to uppercase.
Test that the CLI handles an empty string correctly.
Test that the CLI correctly converts mixed case input to uppercase.

qualitative_rubric: The CLI should handle typical edge cases such as empty strings.
The CLI should be robust against malformed JSON input.
The CLI should perform efficiently with large input strings.
stopping_condition: All public tests pass with 100% success rate.
